name: dogfood-portal
description: Self-hostable hackathon submission and judging platform — Dogfood 2026

scripts.setup: pnpm env:init && pnpm install && pnpm images:pull && playwright install chromium
scripts.env:init: cp -n .env.example .env; cp -n src/api/.env.example src/api/.env; cp -n src/web/.env.example src/web/.env; true
scripts.images:pull: docker compose --profile dev pull --ignore-buildable && docker pull node:24-alpine
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose --profile dev rm -sfv devdb && docker volume rm -f dogfood_devdb-data
scripts.ai:provision: docker compose --profile ai run --rm -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=0 ai python -m app.provision
scripts.ai:provision:local: sh -c 'cd src/ai && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=0 python3 -m app.provision'
scripts.ai:down: docker compose --profile ai stop ai && docker compose --profile ai rm -sf ai
scripts.services:reset: docker compose --profile ai down -v && docker compose --profile ai up -d --build
